name: shortest
description: Shortest route from start to goal around the buildings (dataset obstacle rule, 2 m clearance): grid shortest path straightened between its corners, flown at the maximum speed of 15 m/s. Reference path, not optimized against the cameras; it turns instantly at its one corner.

frame.note: the dataset frame: east, north, up [m]
frame.up_m_note: constant: flight_z_enu_m of the dataset (ground z + 10 m)

time.t0: t = 0 s is the launch, the same t as the camera schedule (camera_schedule_10hz.jsonl)

seen_rule: dataset view_model: within +-30 deg of the camera heading, within 150 m horizontally, and line of sight not blocked by a building (camera_blind_areas_enu.json)
